verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a RESTful API, a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and an MCP server, but nowhere mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. A raw REST API and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks for making your own client, not first-party SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.
